verdict.rationale: Stripe publishes an official OpenAPI specification repository for its API (which Terminal is built on) at github.com/stripe/openapi, providing a machine-readable spec covering the API-based Terminal integration. Missing for 10: a spec discoverable directly under the Terminal docs path itself (probe found 404s at docs.stripe.com/openapi.json) and independent confirmation the repo is kept fully in sync with Terminal-specific endpoints.
